2609.24609.title: GraphToolbox: A Configurable Python Framework for Graph Neural Network Forecasting
2609.24609.paper_summary: Electricity forecasting often involves spatially related signals observed over regions, substations, and feeders, and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) provide a natural way to represent these relations. Building a complete GNN forecasting experiment is nonetheless laborious, because graph construction, model selection, training, aggregation, and interpretation sit in incompatible tools. We present GraphToolbox, an open-source Python framework that unifies these stages in one configurationdriven pipeline built on PyTorch Geometric. It offers data-driven graph construction, an adapter that instantiates and trains 51 of the 65 PyTorch Geometric convolutions together with the recurrent cells of PyTorch Geometric Temporal, online expert aggregation, forecasting interpretability, and significance testing on cached forecasts. We evaluate the pipeline in two case studies. On French regional load, the 48 convolutions included in the complete forecasting sweep fall in a band from 1.14% to 1.60% error, online aggregation lowers this to 0.98%, and the graph models improve on classical additive and boosting baselines. On net-load, direct graph models are less accurate than a classical additive model, while forecasting each physical component separately improves them without closing that gap. Both comparisons use the same experimental interface, illustrating the role of GraphToolbox in systematic architectural evaluation.
2609.24609.paper_summary_zh: 電力預測通常涉及在不同區域、變電站和配電線上觀察到的空間相關信號，而圖神經網絡（GNN）提供了一種自然的方式來表示這些關係。然而，建立一個完整的GNN預測實驗是繁瑣的，因為圖形構建、模型選擇、訓練、聚合和解釋都位於不兼容的工具中。我們提出了GraphToolbox，一個開源的Python框架，將這些階段統一在一個基於PyTorch Geometric的配置驅動管道中。它提供數據驅動的圖形構建、一個適配器，實例化並訓練65個PyTorch Geometric卷積中的51個，連同PyTorch Geometric Temporal的遞歸單元、在線專家聚合、預測可解釋性以及對緩存預測的顯著性測試。我們在兩個案例研究中評估了這個管道。在法國區域負載上，完整預測掃描中包含的48個卷積的誤差範圍為1.14%到1.60%，在線聚合將其降低到0.98%，而圖模型在傳統的加法和提升基準上有所改善。在淨負載方面，直接圖模型的準確性不及傳統的加法模型，而單獨預測每個物理組件則改善了它們，但未能縮小這一差距。這兩個比較使用相同的實驗界面，說明了GraphToolbox在系統性架構評估中的作用。
